Name: Mountain Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
Updated to 1.6
Now Spawns a good amount of Ore/Rocks daily in the caves, and you can build in them
Forage spawns on Grass
Grass is Tillable
Stumps on Grass Respawn.
~~~~~
So its Pretty simple, its a Giant (154x154) Hilly/Mountainous Farm with a Bunch of caves that are all interconnected through ladders.

Should Be 0 issues with Compatibility as its pretty much entirely self-contained, and doesnt add any extra tiles or anything.

[size=5]Forest Entrance is on the East Side! About a Third of the way down that side, its the little ramp that leads off the map.[/size]

Some basic mods I like to recommend for large maps are
[size=3]Upgrade Empty Cabins-[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253[/url]
[size=3]For storage or extra houses to sleep in.[/size]
[size=3]Destroyable Bushes - [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304
[/url][size=3]Please use it to free up area that you would like to build upon that is otherwise blocked by bushes.
Waterproof Items - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6460]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6460[/url][/size]
Always just a good mod to have really.


If you Find any Bugs, or any Tiling errors, please let me know.




To install just unzip and drop in your stardew valley Mod Folder, which should have been created when you installed Smapi

If you want it replacing a map other than the Standard Layout farm please follow these instructions

Open up the mod folder
Open up the content file
at the bottom part you should see this.
      "Changes": [
      {
        "Action": "Load",
        "Target": "Maps/Farm",
        "FromFile": "assets/MountainFarm.tmx"
      },
],
}

The part we want to change is the Maps/Farm
Farm is what the base Standard farm is called
Hilltop is Farm_Mining
Riverland is Farm_Fishing
Forest is Farm_Foraging
Four corners is Farm_FourCorners
Island is Farm_Island
Wilderness is Farm_Combat

Just change Farm in that line to the one you want to replace it with, such as if you wanted a wilderness replacement, replace it with Farm_Combat.

Note that the custom features of those farms, like fish for river, or monsters for combat, will still be active!
